upper_bound_uses: Every request reserves published peak rates. Original pilot settlements retain their recorded peak-rate upper costs. Later successful requests may settle at the documented half-rate only with verified buffered off-peak timing evidence; ambiguous timing and unknown charges retain peak upper costs. These are accounting upper estimates, not provider invoices.
settlement_policy: Always reserve peak rates. Future successful calls settle at half those rates only when authenticated service Date and buffered request/response UTC times prove a wholly off-peak interval; ambiguous timing retains peak. Existing pilot entries are not recalculated.
peak_windows_utc: Monday-Friday 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00; holiday discounts are ignored conservatively.
